title: ask-*/triad CDP focus-steal coverage via sentinel user-active yield
desc: ask gpt / ask claude / ask gemini / ask triad all route through ChromeLauncher + CDP attach which used to steal foreground focus (UIA hwnd attach, SetForegroundWindow). Combined mitigations this session: AppBotPipe allowlist for Minimized Chrome launch, RestoreFocusWithRetryAsync user-active silent yield, VisionWorker sentinel Checkpoint bracket for CDP tab activation.
steps: ASK PATHS: ask gpt = ChromeLauncher spawn minimized -> CDP port attach -> editor target -> send prompt. ask claude = same as gpt + claude.ai target + CoWork dismiss before send. ask gemini = same Chrome CDP + Gemini copyright dialog dismiss. ask triad = parallel fan-out to gpt+claude+gemini, each with its own focus-steal sentinel
SILENT YIELD: sentinel bails silently if user-idle <1.5s mid-retry -- prevents fighting an intentional user focus switch
CHECKPOINT BRACKET: VisionWorker CheckpointFocus bracket catches theft at the CDP-call seam, not only at end of pipeline

SEND PATH: default send uses SendPromptFocuslessAsync first so minimized/hidden Chrome can still receive Enter without tripping the input-readiness watchdog; the old focusful path is fallback only for editors that truly require OS focus
CLEAR EDITOR: ClearEditorAsync prefers DOM.focus + Ctrl+A/Backspace before falling back to Runtime.evaluate, keeping prompt cleanup off the 10s JS timeout path
